note: check-readme-examples.mjs's pre-existing, measured findings. Each package's README shows an example that does not compile against that package's own shipped declarations (issue #908's own reproduction, plus several more found once the gate's cascade-diagnostic handling let it see past unrelated elided-reference noise in the same files). Each is packed content — fixing it moves that package's tree and needs its own version and qualification record (docs/PUBLISHING.md) — so each rides its own package's next version bump rather than landing inside this repository-infrastructure change. This file is a RATCHET, not an exemption: the gate refuses to let the set grow, and an entry that no longer matches anything is itself a finding, so fixing the block and deleting its entry are the same commit. Every run prints the waived set. When this file is empty, delete it and close #908's remaining follow-ups.
